desc:
A sandbox game in which you can dig snow with different shovels and build whatever you want out of it. You also have different items to decorate your building

Play snowballs and have fun

Inspired by the game: PANELKI

PC Controls: 
E - Drop snow,
Ctrl+E - Drop all snow,
Shift - Run

Mobile Controls:
Hold - Drop all snow

Use /votekick [nickname] [reason] to call vote for kick

Join in group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/9275288/Army-of-Robloxers-Bros#!/about
